question: Who among the following personalities is associated with the musical instrument Mandolin?
solution:
The correct answer is __**U Srinivas.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uppalapu Srinivas**, often referred to as **Mandolin Srinivas,** was a renowned **mandolin player** from India.
 
• He specialized in the field of **Carnatic classical music.**
 
• Srinivas introduced the mandolin, a **western musical instrument** not commonly used in Indian classical music, into the traditional Carnatic music fold.
 
• He was known for how he adapted the mandolin, a primarily western instrument, to the unique needs and nature of Carnatic music.
 
• Srinivas first picked up the mandolin at a young age and quickly gained** recognition as a child prodigy in music.**
 
• Over the course of his career, he won several awards for his contributions to music, including the** Padma Shri in 1998, **and left an indelible impact on Indian classical music.
